svg.text: The Johnson Center has 23 group study rooms across three floors. Vertex
knows where every one of them is, and walks you to the door.
Johnson Center, Research Hall, Merten Hall, The HUB.
A map you have opened stays on your phone.
No app store, no account. Add it to your home screen.
No app store. No account. No download. Vertex is a web page
you add to your home screen.
The one in orange is 320H, on the third floor. Vertex walks you
to it from whichever door you came in.
An independent student project. Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by George Mason University.
